abilities.name: Sharky's Bite
abilities.description: While in Nightsoul's Blessing, Mualani's Normal Attacks are converted to Sharky's Bites — auto-targeting wave-chomps that deal Nightsoul-aligned Hydro DMG based on Max HP. Each Sharky's Bite has a 1.8s ICD (gcsim). Charged Attacks are disabled in this state.
_curatorNotes: Frames sourced from gcsim sharkBiteFrames[0] — cold-open variant (0 Wave Momentum stacks). Hitmark 7f.

At 3 Wave Momentum stacks the bite converts to Sharky's Surging Bite with different frames: swap=258, N=144, E=79, Q=82, D=78, J=81 (gcsim sharkBiteFrames[3], hitmark 42f). Stack-gated frame variant cannot be expressed in current schema; reviewer to decide representation.

Wave Momentum stack economy not authored: gcsim grants 1 stack per Surfing Hit (contact while moving in stance) with a 0.7s per-enemy ICD; cap 3. Each Sharky's Bite consumes all stacks. DMG bonus per stack and the Surging Bite conversion at 3 stacks are not authored as effects.
Marked as Prey + Shark Missile spread (up to 5 nearby marked enemies) not authored — additional damage instances triggered by bite-on-marked-enemy with diminishing multiplier.

Each press fires one bite (gcsim resets NormalCounter to 0); not a multi-hit string. Sharky's Bite has its own 1.8s cooldown (gcsim SetCDWithDelay on ActionAttack); not modelled at the normal-ability level.
Charged Attack is disabled in stance (gcsim NextQueueItemIsValid blocks ActionCharge during nightsoul); chargeFrames omitted.

abilities.name: Surfshark Wavebreaker
abilities.description:
Combining her mastery of speed and the waves and water, Mualani can surf anytime, anywhere.
After using this skill, Mualani will gain 60 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Mualani
Continuously consume Nightsoul points. When they are depleted or when the skill is used again, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing will end. The state itself has the following traits:
·Mualani mounts her Sharky Surfboard, increasing Mualani's Movement SPD and interruption resistance. Mualani can move on water and liquid Phlogiston while this state is active, and she will take no DMG from the latter.
·Normal Attacks will be converted to Sharky's Bites, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Hydro DMG based on Mualani's Max HP. Sharky's Bites can be used in mid-air. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
·When she makes contact with opponents in this state, Mualani applies "Marked as Prey" to them and gains 1 Wave Momentum stack. Max 3 stacks. 1 stack can be gained from the same opponent every 0.7s.

Wave Momentum and Marked as Prey
When Mualani uses Sharky's Bite, her DMG dealt increases based on Wave Momentum stacks. When she has 3 stacks, Sharky's Bite will be converted to Sharky's Surging Bite, further increasing her DMG and removing all her stacks when hitting an opponent.
When Sharky's Bite hits an opponent Marked as Prey, that mark will be removed, and she will fire Shark Missiles at up to 5 nearby opponents Marked as Prey, dealing DMG to them equal to this Sharky's Bite instance and clearing their Marks. If more than 1 opponent is the target of Sharky's Bite and Shark Missiles, the DMG dealt will decrease, decreasing at most to 72% of the original DMG when 3 opponents are targeted.
_curatorNotes: Pattern 1 stance with N replacement (Tier B). Skill opens Nightsoul's Blessing; in-stance N is Sharky's Bite (separate normal ability with conditions.state inStance).

Stance gated by a Nightsoul resource pool: gcsim EnterBlessing(60) with MaxPoints=60, drained at 1 point per 6 frames (=10/sec) → 6s base duration with no movement. Dashes consume +10 each, dash-jumps +14 (the +24 figure in gcsim), jumps +2; Nightsoul also regenerates from A1 (Puffer pickup, +20) and C2 puffer interactions, so effective in-game uptime varies (~12s typical with active movement and Puffer pickups). Authored duration=6 reflects gcsim's no-movement baseline; reviewer to decide whether to model resource pool / regeneration.

Skill cooldown: gcsim sets the 6s cooldown only on stance cancel/exit (cancelNightsoul → SetCD(ActionSkill, 6*60)); no SetCDWithDelay on the cast itself. The CD effectively begins when the stance ends, not when E is pressed. Schema has no field to express "CD starts on stance end" — cooldown=6 is recorded but cooldownStartDelay omitted; reviewer to decide.

Re-pressing E during stance cancels Nightsoul (gcsim Skill function early-returns with skillCancelFrames). Cancel frames: swap=11, N=7, Q=4, D=13, J=12. Not authored as a separate variant — cancel-press behavior cannot be expressed in current schema.
Stack-conditional N animation: see Sharky's Bite ability for the 3-stack Surging Bite variant flag.
Movement/dash/jump frame replacements while in stance (skillDashFrames, skillJumpFrames) not authored — schema does not represent stance-altered dash/jump; reviewer to decide.

abilities.name: Boomsharka-laka
abilities.description: Fires a Super Shark Missile that can track opponents, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Hydro DMG based on Mualani's Max HP.
_curatorNotes: Burst hit lands at hitmark 108 + travel (default 70f in gcsim). Snapshot taken at burstHitmarks=108 (bullet creation), damage applied at +travel.
gcsim ConsumeEnergy(11) is a non-standard call distinct from the burst's true 60-energy cost (sourced from data_gen.textproto: burst_energy_cost=60). Authored energyCost=60.
A4 "Wavechaser's Exploits" stacks add 15%/30%/45% Max-HP flat DMG when consumed by Q (gcsim: 0.15 * stacks * MaxHP). Authored on the passive as a damage skeleton with manual trigger (inherited).

passives.name: Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater
passives.description: When Sharky's Surging Bite hits an opponent, a Puffer will be generated nearby. Mualani will restore 20 Nightsoul points when she picks up a Puffer. Only 2 such Puffers can be created in this way during a single instance of being in Nightsoul's Blessing.
_curatorNotes: Not authored: Nightsoul-point regeneration mechanic. gcsim a1cb generates 20 Nightsoul points (delayed 20f) on Surging-Bite hit, capped at 2 procs per stance. Effect schema has no "Nightsoul point" stat; reviewer to decide whether the regeneration should be modelled as a stance-duration extension or skipped.

passives.name: Natlan's Greatest Guide
passives.description: After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mualani will gain 1 stack of Wavechaser's Exploits, which lasts for 20s. Max 3 stacks. When she uses Boomsharka-laka, Mualani will clear all Wavechaser's Exploits stacks and increase the DMG of this Boomsharka-laka by 15%/30%/45% of her Max HP based on the number of stacks cleared.
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. Likely a flat-DMG add on the burst conditioned on stack count, fired onCast with ability=burst. gcsim implementation: subscribes to OnNightsoulBurst (event from teammates) to grant 1 stack (cap 3, 20s lifetime); on Q cast, ai.FlatDmg += 0.15 * stacks * MaxHP and stacks reset. Authored scaling=45 reflects max-stack value; the 15/30/45 stack ladder cannot be expressed cleanly without a stacks field on damage effects. Reviewer to decide representation.

constellations.name: The Leisurely "Meztli"...
constellations.description:
The DMG dealt by the first Sharky's Surging Bite after Mualani enters Nightsoul's Blessing and the Shark Missiles it triggers is increased by 66% of Mualani's Max HP. This instance of increased DMG is subject to the diminishing DMG rules of Surfshark Wavebreaker.
In addition, while out of combat, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing state consumes 30% less Phlogiston and Nightsoul points.
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. Likely an onHit add to Sharky's Surging Bite (and the Shark Missiles it triggers) — gcsim: c.c1() returns 0.66 added to the bite multiplier on the first Surging Bite per Nightsoul instance, gated on c1Done flag (reset on stance entry). C6 removes the once-per-stance gate. Trigger is one-shot per stance; schema has no "first-of-kind in stance" condition. Reviewer to decide.
The out-of-combat Nightsoul-consumption reduction is a resource-pool effect not modelled in schema.

constellations.name: Mualani, Going All Out!
constellations.description:
Mualani gains 2 of Surfshark Wavebreaker's Wave Momentum stacks when she enters Nightsoul's Blessing state. She will gain 1 stack when obtaining a Puffer.
In addition, whenever Mualani obtains 2 Puffers within a single instance of the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will recover an additional 12 Nightsoul points over 2s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."
_curatorNotes: Not authored: stack-gating and Nightsoul-point regeneration cannot be expressed in current schema. gcsim: c2() sets momentumStacks=2 on stance entry; c2puffer() grants +1 stack per Puffer pickup, and on the 2nd Puffer per stance regenerates 12 Nightsoul points over 12 ticks (1 per 10f).

Practical impact: skipping the cold-open momentum ramp (2 free stacks → 3 stacks after one Surfing Hit), so the first bite often crit-converts to a Surging Bite. Reviewer to decide representation once stack mechanics are schema-supported.
